override.title: Omutegyeki yabingaho
override.hint: Overrides buriijo nizihandiikwa n'endangamuntu yaawe y'omutegyeki n'enshonga - tihariho bwire obu orikuhunama.
override.cancelBookingHint: Okusazamu nikumanyisa okuhandiika n‘akakiiko kaayo nk‘okusazibwamu, kugaruraho obugabe bw‘okukora aha munywani, kandi kureka omwombeki kugaruka kuhandiika okwebembera oku.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: Sazamu okushaba oku? Akakiiko kaayo nako kasazibwamu. Eki nikihandiikwa n’eiziina ryawe n’enshonga yaawe.

detail.disputeOpen: Enkaayana z'obugabe zikingirwe ahari kasitoma ogu - ondiijo munywani we naagira ngu n'owaabo. Nikicwamu aha rupapura rw’Entaana.

cancellation.title: Okushaba kwasazibwamu
cancellation.hint: Okuhandiika n’okuha akakiiko kaayo nibisazibwamu; obugabe bw‘okukora nibugaruka n‘omunywani kandi omwombeki naabaasa kugaruka kuhandiika okwebembera oku.

disputes.title: Obutaikirizana aha bw'obugaiga
disputes.hint: Omunywani ou okwehandikisa kwe kwayangirwe nk’ekihandiiko ky’okugarukamu naabaasa kuhakanisa ngu n’oha oine kasitoma. Reeba embaju zombi kandi ocwemu.

detail.upholdEffect: {{holder}} naguma aine omuguzi. Enkaayana ekingirwe kandi tihaine ekindi ekirikuhinduka.
detail.overturnEffect: Obukuumi bwa {{holder}} obw'okugarukamu nibuhwaho hati kandi omuguzi naahandiikwa ahabwa {{partner}} nk'okwehandikisa okusya.
